reviews.review:
Definitely not an immersive sim.
More like Borderlands with stealth and a bit non-linear maps. 

With these expectations - very solid loot shooter.
Not as bad as some would say. Recommended if on sale.

Dunno how it was in day 1, but after last update, game is good and fun.
To sum it up, it is a pile of poor management (i guess) choices that together resulted in distaster - too much focus on multiplayer, bugs, lack of QoL, 70€ pricetag.
Now game is quite polished, full of QoL improvements and for a price that justifies its... lack of qualities.

It seems that gaming industry (especially Bethesda imho) publish games like "Release garbage, test players patience, gather some feedback, fix it or leave it alltogether".

Sad...

Pros:
Memorable atmosphere
Staking vampires is pretty satisfying
Some of the powers are pretty fun
Some fun weapons, and good enough selection for the situation
Play with friends and characters sometimes has funny dialogue
Overall has fun combat mechanics

Cons:
Only two main maps, game felt short
NPC AI can be lacking at times
Short story, sometimes hard to follow
Some side quests don't feel rewarding enough
Could use one more weapon slot

We got lucky and started playing after one of the big patches that fixed performance.  The game is good over all, has a few flaws, but worth to buy on sale.  If there were a few more updates it could have been worth full price or paying for DLC's for more content.  I don't understand why people who kinda liked the game are giving it thumbs down if the studio is closing down.  The execs aren't gonna read the reviews, they're just gonna see bad reception so they'll think they made the right decision.  If you like the game at least a little, give it a thumbs up so that there's a miniscule maybe even small, but non-zero, chance to make the execs think that they possibly made a bad decision.

Rest in Peace Arkane Austin...
While Redfall still fails to capture the essence of what Arkane has done best in the past I commend the developers that took the time to push out a final update that allows for single player functionality (offline mode), and fixes some game breaking bugs, all while not being endorsed by Microsoft in the process.
I hope all of these devs find work in the industry again and return to making great games that aren't pushed onto them by a conglomerate.
Microsoft ruined a studio that otherwise would have pushed themselves to continue making a better experience for the playerbase.
I do not recommend playing Redfall, but instead recommend playing their greatest hits such as Prey (2017), Dishonored, and Arx Fatalis.
Those games shaped Arkane into what they should be remembered for...
